Card Q&A.a: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include only either a Digimon card with [Garurumon] in its name or a Digimon card with [Agumon], [Greymon], or [Omnimon] in its name, can I only add 1 card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include both a Digimon card with [Garurumon] in its name and 1 Digimon card with [Agumon], [Greymon], or [Omnimon] in its name, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the top of my deck?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Garurumon] in its name and 1 Digimon card with [Agumon], [Greymon], or [Omnimon] in its name among them to your hand. Place the rest on top of your deck in any order.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your other Digimon digivolves, gain 1 memory.
